name: com.maskbreak/mcp
title: Maskbreak
description: Public IP signals (cloud hosting, Tor exits) and Maskbreak API status for fraud checks.

environmentVariables.name: MASKBREAK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Maskbreak API key for your plan's lookup allowance (100,000 a month on the Free plan). Without it, lookups use the rate-limited keyless endpoint. The older SENTINEL_API_KEY name is still read.

environmentVariables.name: SENTINEL_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base URL override, for testing.
